items.zh: 该 keybox 是签发设备的 RKP 身份；在新设备上使用属于 keybox 克隆/冒充，不是合法的跨设备 RKP provisioning。
items.en: This keybox is the issuing device's RKP identity; using it on another device is cloning/spoofing, not a legitimate cross-device RKP provisioning path.

items.zh: Play Integrity、Key Attestation、银行/支付应用可能拒绝，Google 也可能撤销该身份。
items.en: Play Integrity, Key Attestation and banking/payment apps may reject it; Google may revoke the identity.

items.zh: 私钥会被复制到新设备；任一台设备泄露，另一台一起失守。
items.en: The private key is copied to another device; a leak on either device compromises both.

items.zh: age 密码会保存到 0600 文件以支持自动运行；设备丢失或 root 被攻破会泄露。
items.en: The age passphrase is stored in a 0600 file to support unattended runs; losing the device or a root compromise leaks it.

items.zh: OhMyKeymint 的 retire_stale_keybox_bound_keys=true 可能在轮换时删除绑定旧 keybox 的客户端密钥。
items.en: OhMyKeymint's retire_stale_keybox_bound_keys=true may delete client keys bound to the old keybox on rotation.

items.zh: Gist/WebDAV 只保证可用性：远端可被读取、篡改、回放或删除，只靠 age 密码保护机密性与完整性。
items.en: Gist/WebDAV guarantee availability only: the remote may be read, modified, replayed or deleted; the age passphrase is the sole confidentiality and integrity anchor.

items.zh: debug 版 KernelSU 管理器会把 root shell 命令写入 logcat（release 版不会），WebUI 写入的口令 hex 可能被本地日志捕获。
items.en: A debug build of the KernelSU manager logs root shell commands to logcat (release builds do not); the passphrase hex written by the WebUI may be captured in local logs.
